name: HiveMind
notes: Set how often you inspect (Settings › Reminders › Inspect every __ weeks), and a different number for any hive.
Replace queen asks what went in and how: candy cage, released by hand, push-in cage, no cage, on a frame, or your own way. Each sets its own checks, and you can change any day.
Say "put in a new queen with a push-in cage" in an inspection and it offers to set her follow-ups.
Follow-ups set themselves: swarm cells, queenless, a split, a super added, possible disease, a robbing screen. Each hive shows what is coming up, and reminders have Later (+2 days).
